Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Sanjay Kamath. I am a 25-year-old paediatrician living in New Delhi. Deepa Kapoor gave me a cheque for Rs 11,10,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 79762 77208 or email sanjay.kamath@example.in.
